front.title: IPv6-mostly Networks: Deployment and Operations Considerations

abstract.t: This document discusses a deployment scenario called "an IPv6-mostly network", when IPv6-only and IPv4-enabled endpoints coexist on the same network (e.g. local area network (LAN) etc). This approach enables incremental transition from dual-stack to IPv6-only networks by allowing IPv6-capable devices to remain IPv6-only while the network is seamlessly supplying IPv4 addresses to those devices that require them. This document discusses the requirements, recommendations, and challenges associated with deploying IPv6-mostly networks in enterprise and public Wi-Fi environments.
